analysis.reason: RSI 42.7로 과매도 구간 진입, 5일 연속 하락세 지속. MACD 히스토그램은 개선 중이나 여전히 약세 수렴 구간. 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 가능성. 거래량은 5일 평균 대비 1.44배로 증가하며 반등 시도 확인. 그러나 주봉 ADX 41.7로 추세 강도는 유지되나, 일봉상 SMA20(104,764) 하회 중. 섣부른 매수 진입보다는 관망하며 추가 지표 확인 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 42.7, entering oversold territory, continuing downtrend for 5 consecutive days. MACD histogram improving but still in weak convergence. 5-day low is higher than 20-day low, indicating potential Higher Low pattern. Volume increased 1.44x average, confirming attempted rebound. However, weekly ADX at 41.7 shows strong trend, but daily price is below SMA20 (104,764). Prudent to wait and see for further indicator confirmation rather than aggressive buying.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 110,019) / SMA200 (KRW 87,972) — Below mid-to-long-term trend, maintaining strength above SMA200.
· 52-week position (55.4%) + Current price range in historical middle ground.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.1→42.7) — Entering oversold territory, downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1020.2656→371.8626) — Improving, weak convergence continues.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 88,605 KRW) — Bandwidth at 30.85%, relatively wide.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 82,500) — Based on Pivot S1 (KRW 79,040) and 20-day low.
· Swing resistance (KRW 126,170) — Based on R2 (KRW 143,680) and 52-week high.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Potential Higher Low formation) — Possibility of recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.44x) — Increased confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Buy entry after RSI recovers above 50 and MACD confirms golden cross.
